subject: Tabling of the FY2016 Municipal Budget
overview: The Council debated the FY2016 budget and ultimately voted to table it pending answers to outstanding questions regarding infrastructure warranties and departmental funding. The meeting also addressed local business developments, utility petitions, and regulatory concerns regarding massage parlors.

items.title: Student-Athlete Commendations
items.summary: The Council presented citations to the Medford High School girls lacrosse, girls softball, and boys lacrosse teams for their championship seasons.

items.title: Investigation of Massage Parlors
items.summary: Councilors referred a resolution to the police and building departments to investigate several massage parlors, while debating the limitations of local authority versus state licensing laws.

items.title: 5 High Street Scaffolding Investigation
items.summary: The Council approved a request for the building department to investigate long-standing scaffolding at 5 High Street as a public safety and health hazard.

items.title: FY2016 Municipal Budget
items.summary: The Council tabled the proposed $155.6 million municipal budget after a lengthy debate over outstanding departmental inquiries concerning firehouse repairs, senior center programming, and utility expenses.

items.title: Utility Petition: 451 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid to relocate poles and install conduits on Boston Avenue to support a construction project for Tufts University.

items.title: Utility Petition: Sargent Street Gas Main
items.summary: Approved a gas main extension for 73 Sargent Street with a condition that the city review the road repair six months after completion.

items.title: Medford Square Pavement Safety Concerns
items.summary: Referred a resident's concern regarding hazardous pavement ripples caused by bus traffic in Medford Square to the city solicitor for a liability review.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Signage Appeals
items.summary: The Council reversed sign denials for Panera Bread and Noodles & Company at 491-499 Riverside Avenue and requested the developer remove a large dirt mound bothering neighbors.

items.title: Panera Bread Extended Operating Hours
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Panera Bread to operate between 5:00 a.m. and 7:00 a.m., subject to mandatory reviews at three, six, and twelve months.

items.title: Condolences and Moment of Silence
items.summary: The Council observed a moment of silence for several recently deceased community members, including a former police detective.

items.title: Pothole Repair Funding
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to appropriate $75,000 from free cash for pothole repairs.

items.title: Public Access Television Restoration
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to report on the status of the city's public access television station and the upcoming Comcast contract renewal.
